title: Antigravity IDE Settings
description: Configuration schema for Google Antigravity IDE settings, including OpenAI-compatible custom AI model providers.

antigravity.ai.customProviders.description: List of registered custom OpenAI-compatible AI model providers in Antigravity IDE.

CustomProvider.description: Definition of an OpenAI-compatible custom model provider in Antigravity IDE.

name.description: Display name of the custom model provider in the Settings UI (e.g., 'BytesBrains Cruise').

apiKey.description: API key or dynamic environment variable expansion string (e.g., '${env:CRUISE_API_KEY}').

models.description: List of virtual model lane identifiers displayed in the IDE chat dropdown selector.
